questions.question:
What of the following statement(s) is/are true?

I. 2⁴⁰⁰ > 3³⁰⁰

II. 3⁴⁰⁰ > 4³⁰⁰
questions.solution:
**Given,**

I. 2⁴⁰⁰ > 3³⁰⁰

II. 3⁴⁰⁰ > 4³⁰⁰

**Formula:**

By using the law of indices:

**Laws of Indices:-**

[(am )ⁿ] = amⁿ

**Calculation:**

I. 2⁴⁰⁰ > 3³⁰⁰

⇒ (2⁴)¹⁰⁰ > (3³)¹⁰⁰

⇒ 16¹⁰⁰ > 27¹⁰⁰

The given statement is incorrect.

II. 3⁴⁰⁰ > 4³⁰⁰

⇒ (3⁴)¹⁰⁰ > (4³)¹⁰⁰

⇒ 81¹⁰⁰ > 64¹⁰⁰

The given statement is correct.

questions.question: What is the sum of first 30 even numbers?
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

Sum of fist n even numbers = n (n + 1)

**Calculation:**

Sum of first 30 even numbers 

⇒ 30 × (30 + 1)

⇒ 30 × 31

⇒ 930

questions.question: How many numbers are there from 80 to 120 which are divisible by both 7 and 5?
questions.solution:
**Given,**

The given numbers are 7 and 5.

**Concept:**

The least number which is exactly divisible by each one of the given numbers is called their LCM.

**Calculation:**

LCM of 7 and 5 = 35

Multiple of 35 are = 35, 70, 105, 140

So, we can say there is only 1 number 105 from 80 to 120 which is divisible by 7 and 5.

questions.question: If a + b = 10 and ab = 5, then what is the value of a² + b²?
questions.solution:
**G****iven,**

a + b = 10

ab = 5

**F****ormula:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**C****alculation:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ 10² = a² + b² + 2 × 5

⇒ 100 = a² + b² + 10

⇒ a² + b² = 100 – 10

∴ a² + b² = 90

questions.question: The income of C is 30% more than income of B and the income of B is 30% more than the income of A. The income of C is how much percent more than the income of A?
questions.solution:
**Given,**

Income of C is more than that of B by 30%

Income of B is more than that of A by 30%

**Fo****rmula:**

x as a percent of y = (x/y) × 100

**C****alculation:**

Let income of A be Rs 100

Income of B = 100 × (130/100) = Rs. 130

Income of C = 130 × (130/100) = Rs. 169

Income of C is more than income of A by = Rs. 169 – Rs. 100 = Rs. 69

∴ Income of C is more than income of A by (in %) = (69/100) × 100 = 69%

Average of 50 numbers was calculated as 18. Three numbers 18, 32 and 65 were wrong taken as 25, 29 and 56. What will be the correct average?
questions.solution:
**G****iven,**

Average of 50 numbers = 18

**Fo****rmula:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of all observations

**C****alculation:**

Sum of all 18 numbers = 50 × 18 = 900

Correct sum of 18 numbers = 900 + 18 + 32 + 65 - 25 - 29 - 56 = 905

∴ Correct average of 18 numbers = 905/50 = 18.1

**Short Trick:**

∴ Correct average of 50 numbers = 18 + (18 + 32 + 65 – 25 – 29 – 56)/50 = 18 + (5/50) = 18.1

questions.question: Rahul is 50 years old and Mohit is 70 years old. How many years ago the ratio of their ages was 1 : 2?
questions.solution:
**Gi****ven,**

Age of Rahul = 50 years

Age of Mohit = 70 years

**Ca****lculation:**

According to the question

(50 – x)/(70 – x) = 1/2

⇒ 2(50 – x) = (70 – x)

⇒ 100 – 2x = 70 – x 

⇒ 2x – x = 100 – 70

⇒ x = 30

∴ 30 years ago the ratio of their ages was 1 : 2.

questions.question: Anuj’s efficiency is 150% of Vinod efficiency. If Anuj can complete a piece of work in 10 days, then how much time (in days) will they both take to complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**G****iven,**

Anuj’s efficiency is 150% of Vinod efficiency.

Anuj can complete a work in 10 days

**For****mula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time Taken

**Calcu****lation:**

Let efficiency of Vinod be 2 units/day

Hence, efficiency of Anuj = 2 × (150/100) = 3 units/day

Now, total work = 3 × 10 = 30 unit

∴ Time taken by Anuj and Vinod to complete the work = 30/(3 + 2) = 30/5 = 6 days
